description: Create a RECORD template for printing/export (PDF/HTML) — that is, set HOW a record looks on paper or in a file: a blank to fill in by hand, a form, a delivery note, an act, a log, a checklist. 🚨 Call it when the user asks for a printed look of records or for the same record in Excel/Word/PDF — in ANY language, and even when it is one phrase inside a long project description or a pasted format specification. Do not miss it: such a request often stands in the FIRST description and gets lost among the entities and fields. Put a field's 'html_name' into body WITHOUT any brackets (e.g. Full Name). Get html_name through get_form_fields. If this form already has a template with this name, it returns an error — use update_record_template.

body.description: The template's HTML body (use the fields' html_name as plain text, without brackets)

name: create_record_template
